name: Grand Orgen
desc: A rare ingot with a mysterious hue. It's easy to work with despite being impressively solid, so for adept crafters, mass-producing sturdy armor and powerful weapons with this isn't beyond the realm of possibility.

eff.name: Synthesis: ATK Up+
eff.desc1: Using this as an ingredient for synthesis increases the synthesized item's ATK by [Lv. x 1].

eff.name: Synthesis: All Stats Up
eff.desc1: Using this as an ingredient for synthesis boosts all stats of the synthesized item by [Lv. x 1].
